description: Open, edit, run, and debug the workspace of a tOS (Raspberry Pi 5) board from VS Code on your PC, and run Jupyter cells on the board. No VS Code Server is installed on the board.
capabilities.untrusted: The remote terminal and debug configuration are applied only in trusted workspaces.
config.title: tOS Remote
config.host: Board IP address or host name
config.remoteWorkspace: Workspace folder under the board user's home directory (`/home/<user>/`). Enter only the path after the home directory (for example `Workspace` or `class/vision`). It is created on the board if it does not exist. Only folders under the home directory can be used because the user has full access only there.
config.localWorkspace: Local workspace folder path on this PC where the remote source code copy is kept and synced.
config.driveLetter: Drive letter to mount the workspace on (for example `Z:`). Leave empty to pick a free letter starting from Z:.
config.identityFile: SSH private key path. If empty, `~/.ssh/id_ed25519`, `id_ecdsa`, and `id_rsa` are tried in order, and `~/.ssh/id_ed25519` is created when registering a key.
config.pythonCommand: Python command used to run scripts on the board
config.pythonLibraryPaths: Python package paths on the board to copy locally for IntelliSense (Pylance). If empty, they are detected automatically (global site-packages, `~/.local`, and virtual environments in the workspace). Paths set here are all treated as required.
config.pathMappings: Additional remote → local path mappings for terminal links. `local` can use `${workspaceFolder}`.
config.rclonePath: Path to an rclone executable you provide (for offline use). If empty, the extension uses an installed supported version, then tries a package manager or the verified official download.
config.packageExcludeNewer: Install board packages (debugpy, Jupyter) as they were on this date, for example `2026-10-01` (uv `--exclude-newer`). Use the same date on every PC to install identical versions on all boards in a class. If empty, the latest versions compatible with the board's Python are used.
config.jupyterAutoSelectKernel: In the remote workspace window, start Jupyter on the board when a notebook or a Python file with `#%%` cells is opened, and select the board's kernel automatically. The first time, choose the kernel once from the list; it is remembered for each board. Nothing is started if Jupyter is not installed on the board.
debugger.label: tOS Remote Python
debugger.program: Python file to run (${file} or a path in the remote workspace)
debugger.snippet.description: Run and debug the current Python file on tOS
task.file: File path relative to the remote workspace
walkthrough.title: Get Started with tOS Remote
walkthrough.description: Set up your PC to open the workspace of a tOS board. Steps are checked automatically when they are already done.
walkthrough.rclone.title: Install rclone
walkthrough.rclone.description:
Uses an available package manager to install rclone, or downloads the latest official release and verifies its SHA-256 before installing it for this extension. This is done only when needed.
[Install rclone](command:tosRemote.installRclone)
walkthrough.board.title: Enter Board Settings and Test the Connection
walkthrough.board.description:
Check the board host, user, and workspace path in the tOS Remote panel in the sidebar, then test the connection.
[Open Panel](command:tosRemote.panel.focus)
[Test Connection](command:tosRemote.testConnection)
walkthrough.sshKey.title: Register an SSH Key
walkthrough.sshKey.description:
Enter the board password once to register your PC's SSH public key. After that, the terminal, run, and debug work without a password.
[Register SSH Key](command:tosRemote.setupSshKey)
walkthrough.open.title: Open the Remote Workspace
walkthrough.open.description:
Sync the board workspace to a local folder on this PC and open it in VS Code, in the current window or a new window.
[Open Remote Workspace](command:tosRemote.openWorkspace)
